jobDescription:
Company Description

Blend is a premier AI services provider, committed to co-creating meaningful impact for its clients through the power of data science, AI, technology, and people. With a mission to fuel bold visions, Blend tackles significant challenges by seamlessly aligning human expertise with artificial intelligence. The company is dedicated to unlocking value and fostering innovation for its clients by harnessing world-class people and data-driven strategy. We believe that the power of people and AI can have a meaningful impact on your world, creating more fulfilling work and projects for our people and clients. For more information, visit www.blend360.com.


Job Description

We are looking for a Lead AI Engineer to help shape and build the next generation of Agentic AI and AI-powered engineering systems at Blend360.

This is not a traditional GenAI or chatbot development role. We are looking for an experienced software/AI engineer who understands how to build production-grade agentic systems and, importantly, how to leverage Agentic Engineering as part of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).

You will work across AI engineering, software architecture, agent orchestration, LLM applications, developer productivity, and AI-assisted software development. You will help establish engineering practices around AI agents, context engineering, tool use, evaluations, autonomous task execution, and AI-augmented development workflows.

The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience building and operating real-world Agentic AI systems.


What You'll Do

Agentic Engineering & AI-Augmented SDLC

  • Drive the adoption of Agentic Engineering practices across the software development lifecycle, using AI agents to augment and automate engineering workflows.
  • Leverage tools and approaches such as Claude Code, Claude Code Skills, PI, Hermes Agent, and comparable AI coding/engineering agents as part of day-to-day software development.
  • Build AI-assisted workflows covering requirements analysis, code generation, code understanding, refactoring, testing, debugging, documentation, code review, and deployment.
  • Design agent workflows capable of understanding large codebases, managing context, using tools, executing multi-step engineering tasks, and recovering from failures.
  • Establish best practices around context management, context engineering, tool calling, agent orchestration, guardrails, human-in-the-loop workflows, and autonomous task execution.
  • Design and implement Evals to measure agent correctness, reliability, code quality, task completion, regression, and overall effectiveness.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging agentic coding tools and techniques and identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity and software quality.

Production-Grade Agentic AI

  • Architect and develop multi-agent and agentic systems capable of performing complex, multi-step tasks in production environments.
  • Design agent architectures involving planning, reasoning, tool use, memory/context, execution, reflection, validation, and error recovery.
  • Build agents that integrate with APIs, databases, enterprise systems, developer tools, and other external services.
  • Develop reliable tool-use and MCP-based integrations where appropriate.
  • Build production-grade LLM applications using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, or equivalent orchestration frameworks.
  • Implement RAG, semantic search, vector retrieval, structured outputs, and other LLM application patterns where required.
  • Establish appropriate observability, evaluation, monitoring, security, and guardrails for agentic applications.

Software Engineering & Architecture

  • Provide technical leadership across the design and development of AI-powered software products and platforms.
  • Apply strong software engineering principles including system design, modular architecture, API design, scalability, reliability, testing, CI/CD, and maintainability.
  • Build production-quality services and APIs using technologies such as Python, FastAPI, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms.
  • Work closely with engineering, product, data, and client teams to translate complex business problems into scalable technical solutions.
  • Conduct technical design reviews and provide mentorship to other AI/software engineers.
  • Establish engineering standards and best practices for building AI and agentic applications.

Leadership & Innovation

  • Act as a technical leader for Agentic AI initiatives and influence architecture and engineering decisions across teams.
  • Mentor engineers on AI engineering, agentic architectures, software engineering practices, and AI-assisted development.
  • Stay current with rapidly evolving AI coding agents, agent frameworks, LLM capabilities, evaluation methodologies, and engineering practices.
  • Prototype emerging technologies and transition successful approaches into reliable production solutions.
  • Collaborate with clients and internal stakeholders to identify opportunities where Agentic AI can deliver measurable business and engineering value.

Qualifications

Must Have

  • 6+ years of software engineering / AI engineering experience, with strong hands-on development experience.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals with experience building production-grade applications and services.
  • Demonstrable experience building production-grade Agentic AI systems, beyond simple chatbots or basic RAG applications.
  • Strong understanding of Agentic Evaluation / Agent Evals, including designing evaluation frameworks for autonomous and multi-agent systems.
  • Experience creating evaluation datasets, test scenarios, metrics, automated regression tests, and quality gates for agentic applications.
  • Ability to evaluate agents beyond final-answer accuracy, including planning, tool use, reasoning trajectory, context handling, reliability, safety, latency, cost, and task completion.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Python and modern backend/API development.
  • Experience with LLMs, GenAI, agent orchestration, tool calling, and RAG.
  • Experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, Google ADK, or equivalent.
  • Strong understanding of multi-agent architectures, planning, reasoning, context management, tool use, memory, and agent execution.
  • Experience working with Evals / evaluation frameworks to measure and improve AI/agent performance.
  • Experience with cloud, containers, CI/CD, APIs, databases, and production deployments.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture, debugging, testing, scalability, and production engineering practices.

Agentic Engineering Critical Requirement

The candidate should have practical exposure to using AI agents as engineering tools within the SDLC, not simply developing AI applications.

Experience with tools such as:

  • Claude Code / Claude Code Skills
  • PI
  • Hermes Agent
  • AI coding agents or comparable agentic development platforms

is highly valuable.

Candidates should understand how to use these tools for activities such as:

Context management code generation repository understanding implementation testing debugging code review evaluation iteration


Nice to Have

  • Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and building MCP servers/tools.
  • Experience with Claude, GPT, Gemini, Llama, or other frontier models.
  • Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD, and cloud-native architectures.
  • Experience with LLM observability and tracing.
  • Experience with tools such as Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, OpenTelemetry, or similar.
  • Experience implementing automated agent evaluations, regression testing, and quality gates.
  • Experience with distributed systems and scalable AI inference.
  • Experience working in consulting/client-facing environments.

Additional Information

What Success Looks Like

In this role, you will:

  • Build and scale production-grade Agentic AI systems, not just prototypes or chatbots.
  • Help Blend360 adopt Agentic Engineering across the SDLC.
  • Improve developer productivity through AI-assisted engineering workflows.
  • Establish repeatable approaches for context engineering, agent orchestration, tool use, and Evals.
  • Help teams safely adopt AI coding agents such as Claude Code, PI, Hermes Agent, and emerging equivalents.
  • Raise the engineering quality, reliability, and scalability of AI solutions delivered to clients.
  • Mentor engineers and become a technical authority in Agentic AI Engineering.

We are seeking a motivated and driven DFT Engineers to join our semiconductor design team. title: Sr. Consultant
jobDescription:
Trinity is seeking a Senior Consultant to join our growing Analytics organization with a focus on delivering data and AI-enabled analytics solutions. This role blends strong analytics execution, business understanding and practical application of AI (including GenAI and LLM-based approaches) across commercial use cases.
Trinity is a 1400-person, global organization that partners with ~350 life sciences companies annually. At the highest level, we provide Strategy, Insights, and Analytics support. Within Analytics, we have well-established SME verticals (e.g., forecasting, sales analytics, commercial data solutions, data science, AI/ML solutions).
Trinity is investing in expanding our Analytics Strategy team, a seller-doer group that owns client relationships and overall account delivery. Senior Consultants are responsible for delivery excellence, while helping scale Trinity s AI-enabled analytics capabilities.
This is a unique opportunity to join an established firm and work in an entrepreneurial environment, building and scaling a fast-growing team within a core strategic priority area for Trinity.
Position Summary
Trinity is seeking a talented, committed, and entrepreneurial individual to join our Enterprise Analytics Delivery (EAD) team as a Sr. Consultant. The EAD team acts as the pan-analytics backbone, orchestrating end-to-end execution, client partnership, and commercial growth for complex analytics programs. The Consultant is responsible for:
  • Developing analysis design for client problems, with responsibility for quality, timeliness, and business impact
  • Ensuring technical rigor across a range of analytics approaches (from descriptive and diagnostic analysis to advanced analytics and AI/ML)
The ideal candidate for this position will contribute to the firm s success through a strong work ethic, particularly in team settings, and can communicate with statisticians, data analysts, and business stakeholders alike. The Sr. Consultant should be able to independently run complex analyses, while guiding junior team members and bringing in relevant life sciences context.
Position Responsibilities:
This role is an important position within our team, engaging directly with global clients, leading internal teams, building capabilities and standard operating procedures (SOPs), and collaborating with
seamlessly with integrated Trinity teams across US, EU, and APAC.
Delivery Leadership
  • Lead specific analytical workstreams within a project, from problem framing and workplan development through analysis, synthesis, quality review, and final recommendations.
  • Understand and work with secondary RWE datasets such as claims, EMR, sales Data, Patient Level Datasets, and other real-world data sources to support commercial and analytical insights generation (e.g., IQVIA, Komodo, Symphony, Flatiron, Definitive)
  • Partner with senior project leaders within Trinity to understand and refine the contextual why for business questions and structure the insights such that inform strategy and decision-making.
  • Be responsible for analysis execution using a selection of tools like Excel (along with Copilot), SQL, R, Python, or other analytical tools
  • Identify gaps in analysis plan and data limitations as project progresses, and communicate effectively with project leaders to ensure resolution
  • Apply advanced data science methodologies and AI/ML models for client problems, support the design and deployment Trinity s technology solutions in client environments.
Mentoring and Coaching
  • Mentor and review the work of Associates, Associate Consultants and Consultants, providing feedback to strengthen problem solving, analytics execution, and client readiness.
  • Serve as direct people manager and own reporting lines; Coach team members to build stronger analytical, project management, and communication skills through day-to-day guidance and apprenticeship.
  • Teach junior team members how to use AI tools and automation responsibly in analytics delivery and operational workflows.
  • Support capability building across the EAD team by identifying development opportunities and helping junior staff grow.
Business Development Support
  • Gain methodological/ analytics approach expertise by aiding in proposal development as needed.
  • Contribute to pitch materials and case examples that showcase EAD capabilities across forecasting, brand analytics, RWE, access analytics, sales analytics, advanced modeling, AI/ML, and AI-enabled delivery.
Required Qualifications
  • Education: Bachelors degree in a quantitative, technical, scientific, business, or related field; advanced degree preferred.
  • Work Experience: 5+ years of direct work experience in a related field (life sciences consulting, biopharma analytics, and/or general consulting).
Other Important Skills:
  • Experience in life sciences, including healthcare, pharmaceutical, biotech, or medtech business questions and data.
  • Strong proficiency in analytical tools such as Excel, SQL, R, or Python, with the ability to execute and review complex analyses.
  • Experience across commercial, market, customer, and evidence-generation use cases, including
forecasting, segmentation, sales or performance analytics, access analytics, and advanced modeling.
  • Familiarity with statistical modeling, scenario analysis, machine learning, deployment-oriented workflows, and AI-enabled productivity or automation tools.
  • Experience managing and mentoring junior team members in a professional services, consulting, or analytics environment.
  • Knowledge of implementing custom AI Agents is a plus.

title: DevOps Engineer II
jobDescription:
At PDI Technologies, we empower some of the worlds leading convenience retail and petroleum brands with cutting-edge technology solutions that drive growth and operational efficiency.
By Connecting Convenience across the globe, we empower businesses to increase productivity, make more informed decisions, and engage faster with customers through loyalty programs, shopper insights, and unmatched real-time market intelligence via mobile applications, such as GasBuddy. We re a global team committed to excellence, collaboration, and driving real impact. Explore our opportunities and become part of a company that values diversity, integrity, and growth.
Role Overview:
We are looking for a DevOps Engineer II with strong hands-on experience in cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, automation, and container technologies.
The DevOps Engineer II will be responsible for implementing and supporting DevOps solutions, maintaining CI/CD pipelines, automating infrastructure and operational activities, troubleshooting issues, and supporting application teams across multiple environments.
The ideal candidate should be able to work independently on well-defined requirements, troubleshoot technical issues, and contribute to improving existing DevOps frameworks and standards.
Key Responsibilities:
CI/CD:
  • Build, maintain, and enhance CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar tools.
  • Configure pipelines for application build, testing, packaging, and deployment.
  • Troubleshoot pipeline and deployment failures.
  • Integrate unit testing, code-quality checks, security scanning, and other required quality gates.
  • Work with existing shared pipeline libraries, templates, and CI/CD frameworks.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual deployment activities through automation.
  • Support application deployments across development, test, staging, and production environments.
AWS & Cloud Infrastructure:
  • Provision and support infrastructure primarily in AWS.
  • Work with AWS services such as EC2, ECS, EKS, IAM, VPC, ALB, S3, RDS, Route 53, CloudWatch, and SSM.
  • Troubleshoot infrastructure, networking, IAM, DNS, and application connectivity issues.
  • Support infrastructure changes across multiple environments.
  • Follow established cloud architecture, security, tagging, and operational standards.
Infrastructure as Code:

title: Profit & Loss Manager
jobDescription:
ASB Academy is looking for a commercially strong and entrepreneurial Profit & Loss Manager to take ownership of business growth, revenue and profitability.

This is a leadership opportunity for someone who sees beyond a sales target and understands the complete business - market opportunity, customer acquisition, revenue, pricing, partnerships, costs, margins, people and profitability. We are looking for an individual who can think like a business owner, act with autonomy and deliver measurable outcomes. The person in this role will be expected to shape business strategy, identify growth opportunities, build and strengthen revenue channels, lead teams and take accountability for the overall commercial performance of the business.

The Opportunity
ASB operates at the intersection of EdTech, with learning and capability-building offerings across areas including Blockchain, IT, AI, cybersecurity, cloud computing and emerging technologies. The business serves multiple segments including individuals, universities, corporates and government.
This creates an opportunity for a business leader who can identify where the strongest commercial opportunities lie, build the right go-to-market approach and turn those opportunities into sustainable and profitable growth.

What You Will Own
Your mandate will span the complete business cycle:
Market Strategy Go-to-Market Sales Revenue Customers Partnerships Costs Margins Profitability Scale
You will be accountable for the outcome, not simply the activity.

P&L & Business Ownership
  • Own the end-to-end P&L of the assigned business and take accountability for revenue, costs, margins and profitability.
  • Develop annual and quarterly business plans aligned with growth and profitability objectives.
  • Translate business goals into clear commercial strategies, priorities and execution plans.
  • Own revenue forecasting, budgeting and business performance planning.
  • Monitor business economics and identify opportunities to improve margins, pricing, cost efficiency and contribution.
  • Make commercially sound decisions based on financial data, customer insights and market intelligence.
  • Identify underperforming areas early and take decisive corrective action.
  • Maintain a strong balance between growth, investment, customer value and profitability.
  • Provide leadership with clear visibility on business performance, risks, opportunities and the actions required.

Revenue & Sales Leadership
  • Own the overall revenue strategy and sales performance of the business.
  • Build a scalable and predictable sales engine across relevant customer segments.
  • Identify high-value markets, customer segments, accounts and channels.
  • Drive the complete commercial lifecycle - from opportunity identification and pipeline development to negotiation, closure and revenue realization.
  • Develop strategies to improve acquisition, conversion, retention and customer lifetime value.
  • Lead strategic and high-value customer conversations and negotiations.
  • Develop pricing and commercial models that support both market growth and healthy margins.
  • Build and expand strategic partnerships and channels to create new sources of revenue.
  • Continuously assess sales performance and improve the efficiency and economics of the revenue engine.

Market Development & Business Expansion
  • Identify emerging opportunities across the education and learning ecosystem.
  • Develop a strong understanding of customer needs across individual learners, universities, corporates, government and other institutional segments.
  • Identify new markets, geographies, customer segments and revenue opportunities.
  • Develop and execute go-to-market strategies for new and existing offerings.
  • Use market intelligence, customer feedback and competitive insights to influence business strategy.
  • Identify opportunities for new programs, offerings, partnerships and commercial models.
  • Build a strong understanding of competitive positioning and continuously identify ways to strengthen market differentiation.

Strategic Partnerships & Institutional Business
  • Build and maintain relationships with universities, institutions, corporates, government organizations and strategic partners.
  • Identify partnership opportunities that can create meaningful business value and scalable revenue.
  • Develop commercial partnerships and institutional relationships from opportunity identification through execution.
  • Negotiate mutually beneficial commercial arrangements while protecting business objectives and margins.
  • Build a strong network within the education and technology ecosystem.

Leadership & Team Ownership
  • Build, lead and develop high-performing sales and business teams.
  • Establish clear targets, ownership areas and performance expectations.
  • Create a culture focused on accountability, commercial thinking and measurable outcomes.
  • Develop team capability across sales, negotiation, relationship management and business development.
  • Identify organizational and capability gaps and build the structure required to support growth.
  • Empower teams to make decisions while maintaining clear accountability for results.

Cross-Functional Business Leadership
  • Work closely with Product, Technology, Finance, Operations and other functions to convert business priorities into execution.
  • Bring customer and market insights into product and offering decisions.
  • Partner with Finance to maintain visibility into business economics, forecasts and profitability.
  • Work with Product and Technology teams to ensure offerings remain aligned with market demand.
  • Prioritize initiatives based on business impact, customer value and commercial potential.
  • Proactively remove business bottlenecks and accelerate execution.

What We Are Looking For
We are looking for someone who has the commercial maturity to own a business, not simply manage a function.
The right candidate:
  • Thinks in terms of business outcomes rather than activities.
  • Understands that revenue growth and profitability must go together.
  • Can identify opportunities without waiting for direction.
  • Has strong business and financial acumen.
  • Is comfortable working with ambiguity and making informed decisions.
  • Can convert strategy into execution and execution into measurable results.
  • Understands customers, markets, competition and commercial economics.
  • Is confident in challenging assumptions and proposing better approaches.
  • Takes accountability when results fall short and focuses on solving the problem.
  • Can operate at both levels - strategic discussions with leadership and hands-on commercial execution.
  • Builds teams that take ownership rather than creating dependency.
  • Has the ambition to build and scale, not merely manage an existing operation.

Mandatory Experience & Qualifications
  • 8+ years of relevant professional experience.
  • Mandatory experience in EdTech.
  • Proven experience in Sales and Business Development leadership.
  • Demonstrated experience with P&L, revenue ownership or business-unit ownership.
  • Strong understanding of revenue, pricing, margins, costs, profitability and forecasting.
  • Proven track record of delivering measurable business and revenue growth.
  • Experience building and leading sales/business development teams.
  • Experience in B2B, B2C and/or institutional/enterprise sales.
  • Strong exposure to strategic partnerships and business development.
  • Excellent commercial negotiation and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Strong analytical, strategic thinking and decision-making capabilities.

Preferred Background

Business Head | P&L Head | Business Unit Head | Revenue Head | Growth Head | Commercial Head | Sales & Business Head | EdTech Business Leader

Experience in building or scaling an EdTech/education business, launching new revenue streams, developing institutional partnerships or expanding into new markets will be an advantage.

Why This Role

You will have the autonomy and responsibility to influence business strategy, identify growth opportunities, build revenue channels, develop partnerships, strengthen teams and directly impact the commercial performance of the business.

We are looking for someone who wants more than a designation - someone who wants ownership, influence and the opportunity to build something substantial.
